title: Design and implement the Supabase database schema (users, submissions, record shelf, reactions tables)
story: As a developer, I want a Supabase database schema for users, submissions, record shelf, and reactions, so that the app has a reliable, structured place to store and query anonymous song data.
acceptance_criteria: Tables for users, submissions, record shelf, and reactions exist in Supabase with correct relationships and constraints
Required fields are non-nullable and enforce basic data validation (e.g. foreign keys, correct types)
Sample CRUD queries against each table succeed without errors
Schema is documented (ER diagram or migration file) so the rest of the team can build against it

title: Build the mood/context matchmaking algorithm that queries and returns matched song recommendations
story: As a user, I want to receive song recommendations that match my selected mood and context, so that the songs I get feel relevant to how I'm feeling right now.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mood/context input, the algorithm returns exactly three recommendations
Recommendations are relevant to the selected mood/context in manual spot-checks
No matches / sparse data is handled with a sensible fallback instead of an error or empty crash
Response time is acceptable for a mobile UI (no long blocking waits)

title: Implement haptic feedback for physical interactions (e.g. the needle-drop gesture)
story: As a user, I want to feel haptic feedback when I interact with a record (e.g. the needle drop), so that the interaction feels physical and satisfying rather than just a tap on glass.
acceptance_criteria: Device vibrates/haptic-taps on the needle-drop gesture, verified on at least one physical Android device
Feedback triggers only on the intended gesture, not on unrelated taps
Feature does not crash on devices/emulators without haptic support — it degrades gracefully

title: Implement backend logic for anonymous reactions (written privately against the sender)
story: As a user who submitted a song, I want to see reactions to it without the reactor's identity being exposed to anyone else, so that the emotional feedback stays meaningful without compromising anonymity.
acceptance_criteria: A reaction can be recorded against a submission without storing the reactor's identity anywhere the submitter can access it
The submitter can view reactions without seeing who sent them
Duplicate or invalid reaction attempts are handled without crashing or corrupting stored data

title: Implement user authentication via Supabase anonymous auth
story: As a user, I want to use the app without creating a public profile or revealing my identity, so that I can participate in Vinyl anonymously and comfortably.
acceptance_criteria: A new user gets an anonymous session without entering an email/password
The session persists across app restarts (user isn't unexpectedly logged out)
Auth failures (e.g. no network) show a clear error state rather than crashing the app

title: Build the virtual record room frontend
story: As a user, I want to see my three recommended songs presented as vinyl records in a virtual room, so that discovering music feels immersive and distinct from a normal song list.
acceptance_criteria: The three recommended songs render as vinyl records in the room UI
Screen loads without crashing when there are 0, 1, or 3 recommendations
User can navigate into and out of this screen through the normal app flow

title: Integrate the GPS sensor for approximate location/distance display
story: As a user, I want to see a rough distance or location for where a song was sent from, so that I feel a sense of connection to another person without their exact location being revealed.
acceptance_criteria: App requests location permission and handles both granted and denied cases without crashing
Approximate distance/location displays correctly for a submission with valid coordinates
Missing or unavailable GPS data falls back to a sensible UI state rather than crashing

title: Implement settings and profile backend logic
story: As a user, I want my preferences and account settings saved reliably, so that my experience stays consistent each time I return to the app.
acceptance_criteria: Preference changes are saved and persisted across sessions
Reading settings on app launch returns the previously saved values
Invalid or malformed settings updates are rejected without corrupting stored data

title: Build the song submission feature: record data structure and song API calls, plus the attached message with mood/genre tagging
story: As a user, I want to submit a song along with a short anonymous message and mood/genre tags, so that I can pass along something meaningful to someone else who might need it.
acceptance_criteria: A user can submit a song with a message and at least one mood/genre tag, and it is stored correctly
Required fields are validated before submission (e.g. can't submit with no song selected)
Submission errors (e.g. network failure) show clear feedback rather than failing silently

title: Design and build the onboarding questionnaire
story: As a new user, I want to be guided through an initial mood/context questionnaire, so that I understand how the app works and start getting relevant recommendations immediately.
acceptance_criteria: New users see the questionnaire on first launch and can complete it
Answers submitted are used to generate the first recommendation set without errors
The questionnaire cannot be submitted without the minimum required input, or has an explicit, sensible skip/default path

title: Integrate the accelerometer sensor for shake-based interactions
story: As a user, I want to shake my phone to get a new or urgent recommendation, so that I have a playful, physical way to ask for something different.
acceptance_criteria: A shake gesture is reliably detected within a reasonable sensitivity threshold
Shaking triggers a new recommendation request without duplicate/rapid-fire triggers from one shake
Feature does not crash on devices with a missing or faulty accelerometer

title: Integrate the magnetometer sensor for compass-bearing display
story: As a user, I want to rotate my phone like a compass to see the rough direction a song came from, so that I feel a tangible, almost magical sense of connection to a stranger.
acceptance_criteria: Rotating the phone updates the compass-bearing display in real time
Displayed bearing is reasonably accurate against a known reference direction
Feature degrades gracefully (no crash) on devices without magnetometer support

title: Design the UI/UX for the record room, vinyl cards, and virtual record player
story: As a user, I want the record room, vinyl cards, and record player to feel visually cohesive and intentional, so that the app feels like a crafted experience rather than a generic music list.
acceptance_criteria: All three components follow a consistent visual language (colour, typography, spacing)
Design assets/mockups are reviewed and agreed on by the team before implementation starts
Design meets basic accessibility guidelines (contrast, tap target size)

title: Produce wireframes for core app screens
story: As a designer, I want wireframes for the core screens before development starts, so that the team builds toward a shared, agreed layout instead of guessing at structure mid-sprint.
acceptance_criteria: Wireframes exist for every core screen (onboarding, record room, submission, settings, etc.)
Wireframes are reviewed and signed off by the team before development starts on those screens
Wireframes clearly show the navigation flow between screens

title: Design and build the frontend for the decorated vinyl card component
story: As a user, I want each vinyl record to be visually decorated and distinct, so that each recommendation feels like a unique object rather than an identical list item.
acceptance_criteria: Each vinyl card renders with visual decoration based on its song/mood data
Card handles missing or partial data (e.g. no genre tag) without breaking the layout
Card is interactive (tappable) and communicates state changes clearly (e.g. selected/saved)

title: Design and build the frontend for the settings/profile screen
story: As a user, I want a clear settings and profile screen, so that I can manage my preferences and account without confusion.
acceptance_criteria: Settings screen displays the user's current preferences accurately
User can update and save preferences from this screen without errors
Screen handles the empty/default state gracefully for a first-time user

title: Integration testing across frontend, backend, and sensor components
story: As a team, we want to test that frontend, backend, and sensor components work together correctly, so that we catch integration issues before they affect real users.
acceptance_criteria: The core user flow (onboarding to submission to recommendation to reaction) completes end-to-end without crashes
Sensor-driven features (GPS, accelerometer, magnetometer, haptics) work correctly alongside backend calls
Issues found during integration testing are logged as GitHub issues before the sprint ends
